requirements.statement: Implement one Agent-neutral conversational Core and deterministic generated Codex, Claude Code, WorkBuddy, generic Agent, and generic MCP Host Integration Bundles.

Use Runtime MCP facts and schemas to guide discovery, tutorial, project onboarding, Lifecycle CRUD, Harness matching, combined planning, Goal Target Loop, progress, evidence, recovery, acceptance, release, upgrade, and rollback journeys.

Prove real Codex and Claude Code installation, designated-human WorkBuddy, independent Host, generic MCP, headless degraded recovery, exact Candidate pairing, impact closure, and NO_REGRESSION.
Synchronize Expert README, quickstart, tutorials, Host integration, Lifecycle management, Harness-guided Loop, security, recovery, troubleshooting, versioning, and migration documentation.
Expert is stateless and non-authoritative: it owns no project, Lifecycle, Harness, Goal, Target, Loop, evidence, recovery, acceptance, release, credential, or durable Runtime truth.
Expert never selects, fabricates, authors, mutates, approves, or publishes Harness assets and cannot weaken Harness obligations.
Expert never executes source work, embeds a general coding Agent, stores raw credentials, or bypasses qualified external Agent Runtime dispatch.
Codex and Claude Code preserve identical Core and MCP semantics; WorkBuddy remains designated-human operated without Codex observation.
A future Agent Host can qualify through the public Host Integration Bundle contract without Runtime or Expert Core source changes.
Expert versioning, Candidate, acceptance, release, upgrade, and rollback remain independent of Runtime and declarative Lifecycle versions.
When Expert or one Host adapter is unavailable, administrator and machine recovery remain possible without silently presenting a direct ordinary-human fallback.

Expert documentation enables a new ordinary user to install, learn, onboard a project, manage Lifecycles, run a Harness-guided Loop, recover, and understand authority without prior CLI, HTTP, MCP-name, digest, or schema expertise.
Expert acceptance closes only on exact installed Expert 2.0.0 and compatible Runtime 6.0.0 Candidate evidence with complete inherited, Host, MCP, impact, and NO_REGRESSION closure.
